examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

items.wordHook: a 金(gold) case holds a bright 表(show) face → the 錶(watch).

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 她看書看得很快。
examples.pinyin: Tā kànshū kàn de hěn kuài.
examples.english: She reads very fast.

examples.chinese: 啊！今天是你的生日。生日快樂！
examples.pinyin: Ā! Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì. Shēngrì kuàilè!
examples.english: Ah! It is your birthday today. Happy birthday!

examples.chinese: 朋友常來找我，他們都覺得坐捷運來我家，又快又方便。
examples.pinyin: Péngyǒu cháng lái zhǎo wǒ, tāmen dōu juéde zuò jiéyùn lái wǒ jiā, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: My friends often visit me. They all think taking the MRT to my house is both fast and convenient.

examples.chinese: 宜文，生日快樂！
examples.pinyin: Yíwén, shēngrì kuàilè!
examples.english: Happy birthday, Yiwen!

examples.chinese: 期中考快要到了，老師說我們可以去圖書館對面的大教室看書。
examples.pinyin: Qízhōngkǎo kuàiyào dào le, lǎoshī shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù túshūguǎn duìmiàn de dà jiàoshì kànshū.
examples.english: The midterm exam is coming soon. The teacher said we could use the big classroom across from the library for studying.

items.wordHook: a 忄(heart) takes a 夬(decisive) leap → quick as a blink: 快(quick).

examples.chinese: 這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 昨天洗的衣服乾了沒有？這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xǐ de yīfu gān le méiyǒu? Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: Are the clothes washed yesterday dry yet? I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 這個社區很安全，不用擔心小偷來偷東西。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū hěn ānquán, búyòng dānxīn xiǎotōu lái tōu dōngxi.
examples.english: This community is very safe; you don't need to worry about thieves coming to steal things.

examples.chinese: 我剛買的皮包被小偷偷了，讓我又生氣又難過。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng mǎi de píbāo bèi xiǎotōu tōu le, ràng wǒ yòu shēngqì yòu nánguò.
examples.english: The purse I just bought was stolen by a thief, which made me both angry and sad.

examples.chinese: 我聽見樓下有奇怪的聲音，是不是有小偷啊？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn, shìbushì yǒu xiǎotōu a?
examples.english: I hear a strange sound downstairs—is there a thief?

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 他不會做飯，所以三餐都在外面吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù huì zuòfàn, suǒyǐ sāncān dōu zài wàimiàn chī.
examples.english: He doesn't know how to cook, so he eats all three meals out.

examples.chinese: 他不會做飯，所以三餐都在外面吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù huì zuòfàn, suǒyǐ sāncān dōu zài wàimiàn chī.
examples.english: He doesn't know how to cook, so he eats all three meals out.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 我們都是好同學，應該互相幫助、互相學習。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shì hǎo tóngxué, yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù, hùxiāng xuéxí.
examples.english: We are all good classmates; we should help each other and learn from each other.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，幸福就是在身邊有一群願意互相幫助的好友。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xìngfú jiùshì zài shēnbiān yǒu yī qún yuànyì hùxiāng bāngzhù de hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: To me, happiness is having a group of good friends around who are willing to help each other.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, yǒu rén shuō xiàtiān kāi lěngqì bùrú kāi chúshījī, bùguò yǒu zhuānjiā biǎoshì, tāmen de gōngnéng wúfǎ hùxiāng qǔdài.
examples.english: In Taiwan, some people say that in summer, turning on the air conditioner is not as good as turning on a dehumidifier, but some experts say that their functions cannot replace each other.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

items.wordHook: Combining 零(zero) and 食(food): 零食 means snack, junk food.

examples.chinese: 華人喜歡像二、六、八的數字，這幾個數字都是雙數，有很多好事一起來的意思。
examples.pinyin: Huárén xǐhuān xiàng èr, liù, bā de shùzì, zhè jǐ ge shùzì dōu shì shuāngshù, yǒu hěn duō hǎoshì yìqǐ lái de yìsi.
examples.english: Chinese people like numbers like two, six, and eight; these numbers are all even numbers, which means many good things come together.

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi péiyǎng dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì, bié bèi shēnbiān gèzhǒng xùnxī zuǒyòu.
examples.english: We should cultivate the ability to think independently; don't be controlled by all kinds of information around you.

examples.chinese: 仔細地思考是為了防止做出錯誤的決定。
examples.pinyin: Zǐxì de sīkǎo shì wèile fángzhǐ zuò chū cuòwù de juédìng.
examples.english: Careful thinking is to prevent making wrong decisions.

items.wordHook: Engaging deep 思(think) reflections to thoroughly 考(test) a theory: 思考 means ponder.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē yǒu shí'èr ge lúnzi, dàyuē néng zài èrshíwǔ dūn de wùpǐn.
examples.english: This truck has twelve wheels and can carry about twenty-five tons of goods.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

items.wordHook: Combining 各(individual) and 位(seat): 各位 means everybody.

examples.chinese: 我有很急的事找張先生，請他到辦公室後回電，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn jí de shì zhǎo Zhāng xiānsheng, qǐng tā dào bàngōngshì hòu huídiàn, xièxie.
examples.english: I have something very urgent to discuss with Mr. Zhang; please have him call back after he arrives at the office. Thank you.

examples.chinese: 我去樓下的超市買點菜，待會兒做些家鄉菜給你嘗嘗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù lóuxià de chāoshì mǎi diǎn cài, dàihuìr zuò xiē jiāxiāng cài gěi nǐ chángchang.
examples.english: I'm going to the supermarket downstairs to buy some groceries; in a moment I'll cook some hometown dishes for you to try.

items.key: ["B4L02-1-21","身分证","身分證/身份證","身分证/身份证","N"]

examples.chinese: 身分證是用來證明一個人的身分時使用的。
examples.pinyin: Shēnfènzhèng shì yòng lái zhèngmíng yī ge rén de shēnfèn shí shǐyòng de.
examples.english: An identity card is used when proving a person's identity.

examples.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
examples.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
examples.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

examples.chinese: 這家店面的租金太高，所以一直租不出去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànmiàn de zūjīn tài gāo, suǒyǐ yìzhí zū bù chūqù.
examples.english: The rent for this retail property is too high, so it has remained unrented.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā chūkǒu de nóngchǎnpǐn hěn yǒumíng, bùdàn jiàgé dī, pǐnzhì yòu hǎo.
examples.english: The agricultural products our country exports are very famous; not only is the price low, but the quality is also good.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 吃飯的時候把筷子插在碗裡，會被臺灣人認為沒有規矩。
examples.pinyin: Chīfàn de shíhòu bǎ kuàizi chā zài wǎn lǐ, huì bèi Táiwān rén rènwéi méiyǒu guījǔ.
examples.english: When eating, sticking chopsticks into a bowl will be considered by Taiwanese people as having no manners.

examples.chinese: 要想成為成功的上班族，一切就得照規矩來。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chéngwéi chénggōng de shàngbānzú, yīqiè jiù děi zhào guīju lái.
examples.english: If you want to become a successful office worker, everything must be done according to the rules.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 訓練出著名跳高選手的教練認為，要跳得高，技巧很重要。
examples.pinyin: Xùnliàn chū zhùmíng tiàogāo xuǎnshǒu de jiàoliàn rènwéi, yào tiào de gāo, jìqiǎo hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: The coach who trained a famous high jump athlete believes that to jump high, technique is very important.

examples.chinese: 我不太會跳高，跳遠倒是跳得還不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì tiàogāo, tiàoyuǎn dàoshì tiào de hái bùcuò.
examples.english: I am not very good at high jump, but as for long jump, I am actually not bad.

items.wordHook: 什(what) + 麼(particle): 什麼 is the everyday question word 'what'.
a 口(mouth) takes 八(eight) sips → 只(only).
a 口(mouth) calls after 那(that) one, then that one → which one is it: 哪(which)?
Combining 導(direct) and 遊(sto wander): 導遊 means tour guide.
Offering sharp 批(criticism) to thoroughly 評(evaluate) performance: 批評 means criticize.
樓(floor) + 梯(ladder): a ladder between floors → stairs.
Folk 歌(song) drama featuring young 仔(child) actors in a stage 戲(play): 歌仔戲 means Taiwanese opera.
Being born (生) and existing (活) is life.
An 目(eye) turns inward to watch itself → 自(self).
An 斤(axe) chops a 貝(sea shell) to test its worth, revealing the true 質(essence).
a 雨(rain) cloud takes a 彐(snout) shape → falling as 雪(snow).
